title: Polygons and composite shapes
canonical_examples_source: Arithmetic self-verified; method ref: NCERT Class 5/6 Maths; format ref: bank uk-ks2-2024 maths.

blocks.content: A polygon is a closed shape made of straight sides. When you join polygons together, you get composite shapes.
A polygon is a closed shape with straight sides. It is named by its number of sides.

blocks.prompt: A closed shape with straight sides is called a ___.
blocks.explain: Any closed, straight-sided shape is a polygon.
blocks.rule: A polygon is a closed shape with straight sides, named by its number of sides.

practiceItems.prompt: a closed shape made of straight sides

blocks.content: A composite shape is made by joining simpler shapes together, like a square joined to a triangle.

blocks.question: A shape made by joining a square and a triangle is a:
blocks.explain: Two simpler shapes joined together make a composite shape.
blocks.rule: A composite shape is made of simpler shapes joined together.

practiceItems.prompt: a shape made of simpler shapes joined is a ___ shape
a closed straight-sided shape is a ___

blocks.question: A rectangle is 6 by 4. To make an L-shape you cut a 2 by 2 square out of one corner. Does the area go up, down, or stay the same?
options: Down — cutting out a 2 by 2 square removes 4 square units (24 becomes 20)
blocks.explain: The rectangle's area is 6 x 4 = 24. Cutting a 2 x 2 square takes away 2 x 2 = 4 square units, leaving 24 − 4 = 20. Removing part of a shape must make the area smaller.
blocks.rule: Removing a piece from a shape decreases its area by that piece's area.
blocks.principle: A composite shape's area is built by adding or removing rectangles.
canonical_solution: So the area goes down to 20 square units

rubric.look_for: computes both the rectangle and the cut-out area
subtracts to see the area drops to 20
explains removing area decreases the total

misconceptions.if: thinks cutting changes only the shape not the area
misconceptions.coach: You removed material, so 4 square units are gone.
It is cut OUT, so subtract its area.
